# BYZ scope. One Serbian place near Serres (Strymon region) returns to the empire.
oe_br_take_serres_area = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:SER c:SER = { any_owned_location = { var:oe_theme_region ?= 9 } } }
        c:SER = { random_owned_location = { limit = { var:oe_theme_region ?= 9 } change_location_owner = c:BYZ } }
    }
}
